draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Perinthalmanna, known as the hospital city of Kerala! Under British rule it was the headquarters of Walluvanad Taluk, and nearby Angadippuram was the capital of the old Walluvanad kingdom.
draft.hungryLine: You're right by Manathumangalam bypass, a food street packed with Malabar Muslim food, kuzhimandhi and Tamil restaurants.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Head to Angadippuram, about 5 km away, the temple town that was once Walluvanad's capital. Valyangadi Palli, the oldest mosque in the region, is in town too.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Kurilumala is a little hillock near the bus stand, good for an easy evening walk.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Elamkulam Mana in this area is the birthplace of E.M.S. Namboodiripad, the famous Kerala political leader.

spots.name: Angadippuram
spots.detail: About 5 km away · Temple town and old Walluvanad capital

spots.name: Valyangadi Palli
spots.detail: In town · Oldest mosque in the region

legends.title: The old healers
legends.body: Pulamanthole Mana is known as an ancient herbal medicine centre. It's a reminder of how far back healing traditions go around here.

legends.title: The poet's home
legends.body: Poonthanam Illam at Kizhattoor is the historic home of the poet Poonthanam. It stands among paddy fields on the Nilambur road.

tips.title: Come hungry to the bypass.
tips.body: Most places on Manathumangalam bypass are non-veg, but Omkar and Annapoorna are vegetarian.

tips.title: Go up Kodikuthimala early.
tips.body: It's 2,000 feet above sea level, and the cooler morning makes the climb easier.

story.title: Walluvanad rises
story.body: Angadippuram became the capital of Walluvanad, a kingdom that lasted from about 500 AD until the British era.

story.title: Temple of the kings
story.body: The kings of Walluvanad built Thirumandhankunnu Temple at Angadippuram, with the goddess Bhagavathi as the main deity.

story.title: Taluk headquarters
story.body: Perinthalmanna was the headquarters of the old Walluvanad Taluk in Malabar district.

story.title: Hospital city
story.body: It's a municipality and taluk centre on the Kozhikode-Palakkad National Highway 966, known as the hospital city of Kerala. Manathumangalam, where you are, is its second ward and a busy commercial area.

food.name: Nahdi Kuzhimandhi
food.detail: Pattambi Road · Many varieties of kuzhi mandhi
